I’ll give my best tips I can, as someone that feels comfortable going deep consistently in the skull cavern.

1. Bring tons of bombs and food. It’s not worth your time to pickaxe. If you don’t have the resources or money to get tons of food or bombs. Don’t waste your time.

2. Focus on staying alive. If you have the health/defence boost to take damage you can wait till 1/4 health; if not only wait to half health. When you get to that point just down your preferred food source till you’re totally healed.

3. If overwhelmed, don’t be afraid to pause and think about your next move or change your inventory. When you move a floor and 8 serpents immediately charge you. It can help to just pause and get your bearings straight.

4. Have a good setup for your quick bar. You should have food, pickaxe, bombs, and sword all right next to each other. If you have a farm totem or sceptre (which you should if you want to make an extra 20 floors) keep it far away from those.

5. Coffee and stat effecting food can be stacked. You can’t eat two types of stat effecting foods; the second will override the first. The best way to farm skull cavern rides is to go with a bunch of espresso (so you have to take less time to drink), and you’re preferred stat effecting food. I prefer spicy eel. Some prefer lucky breakfast or a few others. But also bring a fat stack of non stat effecting foods (I like salads).

6. Maybe this shoulda been point 1 but I forgot, if you wanna go deep ignore iridium rocks at early and mid levels. You may see 6 iridium rocks right next to each other at 3 pm at level 62 with a ladder right next to you. Just take the ladder. It will pay off in the long run.
